subject: Finova DPA: redlines, breach-notify timing and e-sign path
messages:
From: Susan Reddy <susan.reddy@finova.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DPA redlines & breach notification timing

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Finova is excited about Redwood for the next phase of our compliance-grade feature rollout. Procurement asked me to send our standard DPA redlines back to you. Two items are top of mind for them and legal:

- Breach notification: Finova legal is pushing for a 48-hour maximum for initial notification to impacted parties and regulators.
- Subprocessors: we need a more granular subprocessors table and 30-day notice for additions, plus a requirement to provide contact points for production-impact incidents.

I've attached our redlines (Finova_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx). Are you able to sign via AdobeSign or DocuSign? Procurement prefers AdobeSign but we understand vendors often use DocuSign.

Can you confirm turnaround timing? Our ideal is to get a countersigned DPA to procurement by Feb 15 so we can close the PO.

Thanks,
Susan Reddy
Senior Counsel — Finova Capital
[susan.reddy@finova.com]

Attachment: Finova_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx (Word redline)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Susan Reddy <susan.reddy@finova.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines & breach notification timing

Hi Susan — thanks for the redlines and for flagging the timeline. Short answer: we want to be responsive and align with Finova's needs, but we also have standard incident SLOs to protect customers and investigations. A few quick notes:

- Redwood standard is a 72-hour full notification window for confirmed breaches; we do provide an initial notification/ack within 24 hours for high-severity incidents with an initial summary.
- For subprocessors we maintain a public registry and provide 30-day advance notice plus an opt-out period for new subprocessor categories (we can include the registry link in the DPA).

I'll loop in Aditya (legal) to weigh on the 48h ask and whether a 24h ack + 72h full report is acceptable. We normally execute via DocuSign; if procurement mandates AdobeSign we can accept it but prefer DocuSign for speed.

Proposed next step: Aditya will provide a tracked redline and a short negotiation note; if Finova can accept the 24h ack + 72h full-report compromise we can generate a DocuSign envelope within 48 hours.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com, susan.reddy@finova.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: DPA redlines & breach notification timing

Hi all — quick legal read and proposed compromise below. Attachment: redwood_dpa_response_redlines.docx (tracked changes).

Summary of position:
- Incident notifications: Redwood can accept an initial materially-sufficient acknowledgement within 24 hours of detection and a full written notification within 72 hours of confirmation of a security event, except where ongoing criminal investigations or law-enforcement requests materially prevent disclosure. For priority-severity incidents (P1/P0) we commit to providing an escalation point and continuous updates until the issue is remediated.

- Subprocessors: we will include a subprocessors registry URL in the DPA and provide 30-day notice of new subprocessor additions. We can also provide production contact points for incidents where the subprocessor is the root cause.

- Evidence & logs: we will provide reasonable logs and evidence consistent with our retention policies and privacy obligations; we can add a cross-reference to our security documentation and SOC 2 report delivery terms.

Counterparty ask: if Finova requires a strict 48-hour full-notify obligation without carveouts, we would need to align on defined exceptions (investigations, law enforcement) and potentially limited remedies. Alternatively, we can accept 48 hours for initial acknowlegment + 72 hours full unless Finova is prepared to accept the exceptions in writing.

Execution path: DocuSign preferred; we can send a DocuSign envelope with the agreed redline and metadata. If Finova strictly requires AdobeSign/ESign vendor we can accommodate but expect a 24–48 hour additional turnaround.

Next steps: Susan — if the 24h ack + 72h full report is acceptable, please confirm and we'll send the DocuSign for signature. If procurement insists on 48h full notify, share the procurement team point-of-contact and we'll schedule a quick call to resolve.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com

Attachment: redwood_dpa_response_redlines.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines & breach notification timing

Chloe / Aditya — quick note from the GTM side: procurement deadlines are real and Finova has a hard PO cutover target. If they're flexible on the exact remedies language we should prioritize speed. Suggested commercial compromise: accept 24h ack + 72h full report with a defined "escalation for regulators" clause that commits us to coordinate with Finova's security team, and offer a one-time onboarding credit if we need to accept an unusually tight 48h full-notify requirement.

If needed, I'll join the procurement call to fast-path the remaining items.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations

From: Susan Reddy <susan.reddy@finova.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines & breach notification timing

Chloe / Aditya,

Appreciate the thoughtful proposal. Procurement is willing to accept the 24-hour acknowledgement + 72-hour full notification compromise provided:

- Redwood commits to a named escalation point for P0/P1 incidents and provides continuous updates until remediation.
- Redwood will include the subprocessors registry link in the DPA and provide 30-day notice for additions.
- Finova's procurement still prefers AdobeSign but we can accept DocuSign if you confirm the envelope will be sent to procurement@finova.com and legal@finova.com simultaneously.

I've attached procurement's checklist (finova_procurement_requirements.pdf). Please send the signature-ready DPA via DocuSign to the two addresses. We would like the executed DPA returned by Feb 15 to keep the PO timing.

Thanks,
Susan

Attachment: finova_procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Susan Reddy <susan.reddy@finova.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com, procurement@finova.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: DPA execution plan + DocuSign envelope

Susan — great, thanks for confirming. Per the agreed compromise we will:

- Send a DocuSign envelope to procurement@finova.com and legal@finova.com within 24 hours. Link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/FAKE-DOCUSIGN-LINK-12345
- DPA will include: 24-hour initial acknowledgement commitment for P0/P1 detection, 72-hour full written notification with carveouts for ongoing law-enforcement investigations, subprocessors registry URL and 30-day notice, and named escalation contacts.
- Provide SOC 2 summary and instructions for requesting logs/evidence as set out in the attached redwood response redlines.

If procurement still prefers AdobeSign after review, reply-all and we'll route to AdobeSign (expect +24–48hr turnaround). If you confirm receipt of the DocuSign envelope, we'll mark the thread as in-signature and target Feb 15 for completion.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com

Attachment: redwood_dpa_response_redlines.docx
